about: The specification of @noble-collective/userdata/scripture (ARCHITECTURE §9c). Hand-reviewed: every case states what a reader should get. The TypeScript module and the mobile app's Dart copy must both pass it exactly. chapterLengths = the BSB (Noble-Imprint-Resources bibles/bsb/references.json), verses per chapter, chapter 1 first. find: refs omit "implied"/"continuation" when false; "context" (when given) is the whole text the bare-group book is read from, and "text" sits inside it. resolve: "passage" = formatPassage of the verses, "problems" defaults to [].
